problem: The service did not reach enough customers to sustain itself.
title: Quibi launches a short-video streaming service and shuts down six months later
context: Quibi raised about $1.75 billion, launched in April 2020 and struggled to find viewers.
decision_made: Wind down the business and return cash to shareholders.
action_taken: Founders published a letter on 21 October 2020 saying they had considered and exhausted every option.
observed_outcome: The service shut down about six months after launch. The founders cited either the idea or the timing as the likely cause.
lessons: Heavy funding does not guarantee product-market fit, and a founder's own explanation may not identify the true cause.
limitations: Subscriber numbers were not disclosed by the company. Reasons are the founders' own view.

claims.claim_text: Quibi's leaders chose to wind down the service and return cash to shareholders.
The service shut down about six months after launching.
